listingTitle: Lwenki Key Holder for Wall, Decorative Key and Mail Holder with Shelf Has Large Key Hooks for Bags, Coats – Paulownia Wood Key Hanger with Mounting Hardware (9.8”W x 6.7”H x 4.2”D) (Brown)
listingLines: KEEP TRACK OF KEYS and other items attractively with the Lwenki Key Holder for wall with shelf. This entryway shelf with hooks corrals keyrings, wallets, dog leashes and coats in 1 central location.
STRONG, LIGHTWEIGHT paulownia wood makes the Lwenki Mail and Key Holder for wall a warm and inviting focal point of your foyer. Unique knots and grain patterns ensure that each is truly 1-of-a-kind.

UPGRADED HOOKS give our wall mount key holder more versatility of use. Use the key hooks to reduce clutter in your home’s entryway, at the office to hold coats and in the bedroom for robes and towels.
INCLUDES DETAILED INSTRUCTIONS for easy 3-step installation. The Lwenki Wall Shelf with hooks also comes with 3 concrete anchors, 3 drywall anchors and 3 screws so you can mount it immediately.
SURPRISE A FRIEND with this beautiful key hanger for wall with shelf. Compatible with most room aesthetics, the Lwenki Keys Holder is an attractive and convenient addition to any entryway wall decor.
